answer_3.quote: Given a caption and candidate synsets s 1 , ..., s n where n > 1, we generate n new versions of the caption, where in sentence c i we replace the phrase in question with a phrase representing synset s i . This representative phrase could be the synset name or an example of the synset. BERT then calculates the probability of each synset phrase via masked language modelling. We select the synset with the highest probability.
